entry.title: Federal judges in Colorado are fed up with ICE re-arresting the same immigrants
entry.summary: A federal judge in Colorado has found ICE in contempt for ignoring court orders to not immediately re-arrest detainees they've ordered released.

entry.title: California Democrat Rep. Gomez resigns following ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations
entry.summary: California Congressman Rep. Jimmy Gomez says he will resign after a House Ethics report concluded Gomez's actions violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances."

entry.title: Ex-White House AI advisor weighs in on national security as Huang is back as Nvidia CEO
entry.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back in leadership after resigning recently. Ben Buchanan, a Biden administration AI adviser, discusses what that means for the U.S. national security and chip exports.

entry.title: NPR staff's 2026 picks for Books We Love
entry.summary: NPR's annual books recommendation engine, Books We Love, is out now. Scott Detrow speaks with NPR's Andrew Limbong about staff picks.

entry.title: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
entry.summary:
Women who have advocated for DEI in tech say Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA as CEO sends a message that in Silicon Valley, all that matters is money.

entry.title: Discursive Verses: Can a trap revivalist resolve Atlanta street rap's authenticity crisis?
entry.summary: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: Belly Gang Kushington epitomizes an ongoing battle in the city's local scene.

entry.title: Mending relationships over the holidays? Considering a truce? NPR wants to know
entry.summary: Has a political or social issue broken down a relationship that was important to you? Can it be repaired? Tell us what's going on. You might be asked to participate in a possible upcoming segment on All Things Considered.

entry.title: 'Medicare for all' is back on the drawing board. Does it stand a better chance this time?
entry.summary: Several newly elected Democratic U.S. senators campaigned on Medicare for All. Could this be the time it actually gets traction?

entry.title: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
entry.summary: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Huang's return as a national security risk.

entry.title: Here are the Books We Love: 380+ great 2026 reads recommended by NPR
entry.summary: Our annual reading guide returns with 380+ new titles handpicked by NPR staff and trusted critics. Find 14 years of recommendations all in one place — that's more than 4,700 great reads.
